mentions.name: BitGrid
mentions.description: BitGrid is a bit-level systolic array hardware concept that, if it works, could cut roughly 95% off the power and silicon costs of LLM compute, with trillion-dollar data centers as the scale of the target. The author says it differs from prior attempts, which involved RAM or a CPU.
mentions.problem: LLM compute is extremely power- and silicon-intensive, with costs approaching trillion-dollar data center scale.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on an idea (BitGrid, a bit level systolic array) referenced here many times, that, if it works, could cut 95% off the power and silicon costs of LLM compute. (Think $1 Trillion data centers)
